annotations.title: Render a motion ad from a Library card

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Turns one Library image (the card) into a 6-15 s motion ad: hook (push-in on the card), up to 3 body beats (pans with the text), then a CTA end card in the brand color with the CTA and the link host. 9:16 unless `aspect` is 1:1 or 16:9. The text is used exactly as given; it is not rewritten. Saves a new draft in the card's brand (labels format:motion-ad, source:template); nothing is posted and the card is unchanged. Free. Returns a jobId: poll get_job_status.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/video-studio/templates/motion-ad-from-card/render.)

body.description: Up to 3 beats are used; blanks are dropped.

brandColor.description: #RRGGBB; defaults to the brand profile color.

ctaUrl.description: http(s) link; its host is shown on the end card.

name: render_motion_ad
title: Render a motion ad from a Library card
